record.context_brief: maximal type in almost symmetric semigroups
record.original_question: For each positive integer e, let A(e) be the supremum of the type t(Gamma) over all almost symmetric numerical semigroups Gamma with embedding dimension edim(Gamma) = e. Here Gamma is almost symmetric if for every integer x not in Gamma, either Frob(Gamma) - x lies in Gamma or both x and Frob(Gamma) - x are pseudo-Frobenius numbers of Gamma. Determine A(e).

evidence.quote: A numerical semigroup Γ is almost symmetric if, for every x ∈ Z\ Γ , either Frob(Γ ) − x ∈ Γ or both x and Frob(Γ ) − x are pseudo-Frobenius numbers of Γ . ... Problem 18. Let e ∈ N. Determine A (e) = sup{ t(Γ ) | Γ is almost symmetric and edim(Γ ) = e }.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A numerical semigroup is a subset $\Gamma \subseteq \mathbb{N} = \{0,1,2,\dots\}$ that contains $0$, is closed under addition, and has finite complement in $\mathbb{N}$. The Frobenius number $\mathrm{Frob}(\Gamma)$ is the largest integer not in $\Gamma$. The set of pseudo-Frobenius numbers of $\Gamma$ is 
$$\mathrm{PF}(\Gamma) = \{ x \in \mathbb{Z} \setminus \Gamma : x + s \in \Gamma \text{ for every } s \in \Gamma \setminus \{0\}\},$$
and the type of $\Gamma$ is $t(\Gamma) = |\mathrm{PF}(\Gamma)|$. The embedding dimension $\mathrm{edim}(\Gamma)$ is the cardinality of the unique minimal system of generators of $\Gamma$.

A numerical semigroup $\Gamma$ is called almost symmetric if for every $x \in \mathbb{Z} \setminus \Gamma$, either $\mathrm{Frob}(\Gamma) - x \in \Gamma$, or both $x$ and $\mathrm{Frob}(\Gamma) - x$ belong to $\mathrm{PF}(\Gamma)$.

For each positive integer $e$, define
$$A(e) = \sup\{ t(\Gamma) : \Gamma \text{ is an almost symmetric numerical semigroup with } \mathrm{edim}(\Gamma) = e \}.$$

Determine $A(e)$ as a function of $e$ (in particular, decide whether it is finite, and if so give its exact value).
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches turn up the general framework on almost symmetric numerical semigroups (pseudo-Frobenius numbers, type, embedding dimension) and several related bounds and conjectures (e.g. for generalized numerical semigroups in $\mathbb{N}^d$ of embedding dimension $2d+1$), but no source giving a closed-form value or proof of $A(e)$ for all $e$. The exact supremum of the type over almost symmetric numerical semigroups of fixed embedding dimension $e$ appears to remain open.

status_evidence.snippet: Conjecture about the type of an almost symmetric generalized numerical semigroup of embedding dimension 2d+1 based on computational experiments.
status_evidence.claim: Research on bounding the type of almost symmetric semigroups via embedding dimension is ongoing and stated as conjectural.

status_evidence.title: The Expected Embedding Dimension, type and weight of a Numerical Semigroup
status_evidence.snippet: Studies relationships between embedding dimension, type, and weight in numerical semigroups.
status_evidence.claim: Type-vs-embedding-dimension questions for numerical semigroups remain an active research topic without a known formula for the almost symmetric supremum.
